headline: ProHass Warns El Niño Heat Threatens Peru's Hass Avocado Production
summary: ProHass warned that high temperatures during the flowering period driven by El Niño could sharply reduce Peru's Hass avocado production in 2027.
why: Agricultural yield forecasts affect export supply volumes and global pricing for fresh produce markets.

impacts.name: Agricultural Exports
impacts.why: Crop damage from extreme weather reduces export volumes for agricultural producers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
